supplemental_text.policies/legacy-settlement-exception.md:
# legacy-settlement runtime exception (EA-003 source)

**Approved exception:** legacy-settlement remains on Java 17 until retirement
milestone M-2027-01. Do not upgrade this repository's `maven.compiler.release`
before that milestone. This exception takes precedence over the enterprise
Java 25 runtime policy within the legacy-settlement scope.

Background (approved public summary): the settlement ledger client is not yet
certified on newer runtimes; certification is scheduled alongside the
M-2027-01 retirement. Detailed root-cause records are restricted to the
incident review group and are not part of this document.
supplemental_text.policies/upgrade-runbook.md:
# upgrade-runbook.md

Java upgrade runbook. Update maven.compiler.release, run the full test suite, scan for deprecated APIs, roll out one service at a time. Java 25 upgrades are usually uneventful.
supplemental_text.policies/ci-pipeline.md:
# ci-pipeline.md

CI runs build, unit tests, and license checks on every PR. The Java version matrix covers 17 and 25.
supplemental_text.policies/jvm-tuning.md:
# jvm-tuning.md

JVM tuning notes for Java 25. G1GC remains the default collector; ZGC is available for low-latency services. No action required for most upgrades.
supplemental_text.policies/java-runtime-policy.md:
# Java runtime policy (EA-001 source)

New Java services must target Java 25 unless an approved exception exists.
Existing services should plan upgrades to the current LTS on their normal
maintenance cadence. Exceptions are recorded per repository and take
precedence over this policy within their scope.
